description: A sprite sheet of SIX separate indoor props arranged in a grid of 3 columns and 2 rows, each centered in its own cell. Top row: a wooden framed cottage window with four panes and short curtains, a potted leafy green plant in a clay pot, a wooden drying rack with herbs and cloth hanging. Bottom row: a wooden rice barrel with a lid and a scoop, a ceramic flower vase with wildflowers, a cushioned wooden armchair. Cozy rustic cottage furniture, front view, slight top-down, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, warm wood tones, every item fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with empty space around it, no floor, no wall, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
